status_at_freeze: V3 synthetic infrastructure gate passed; no V3 Study-2 candidate process launched
purpose: Execute the unchanged V1 ten-candidate closure pilot using only the V3 short-workdir and explicit-tempDir infrastructure repair.

unchanged_science.candidate_selection: exact frozen V1 manifest order and raw RTL identities
unchanged_science.constraints: clock and zero-delay I/O XDC read before synthesis
unchanged_science.search: V1 0.75/1.25 initial bracket, 1.5 expansion, [1,200] ns, at most four expansions per side, at most ten bisections, relative width <= 1 percent
unchanged_science.gate: all ten complete; pooled Spearman >= 0.90; median sMAPE <= 0.15; positive mean RF-SFT closure difference with at most one non-tied sign reversal

stop_rules: Freeze and commit this package before the first candidate process.
Refuse if the V1 manifest, candidate RTL, closure Tcl, V3 package, V3 PASS attestation, or Vivado dependency set changes.
Do not read, copy, or reuse V1/V2 candidate outcomes.
Do not change search, thresholds, retries, or failure scoring after a V3 candidate outcome exists.
A missing, invalid, unconstrained, nondeterministic, or repeatedly failed candidate receives zero and makes completeness fail.
If the pilot gate fails, preserve it and stop proxy-dependent downstream physical comparisons.
